name: Generated Photos
tagline: Generated Photos provides AI-generated human face images for use in design, research, and UI mockups where real people's photos cannot be used. All faces are 100% AI-generated and come with control over age, gender, ethnicity, and expression. Designers use them for user personas, app mockups, and training datasets.
